market.question: Will US crude oil reserves fall to 250M by September 25, 2026?

en.title: Venezuela Deal Boosts US Oil Reserves Outlook
en.summary: The probability of US crude oil reserves falling to 250M by September 2026 plummeted 29.5% to 4% following former President Trump's announcement of a massive oil deal with Venezuela. This deal, if realized, would significantly increase US access to global oil supplies.
drivers: Trump announced 'historic' Venezuela oil deal
Deal secures 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil
US to gain 'majority control' of reserves
en.why_matters: This potential deal could drastically alter US energy security and global oil market dynamics, potentially impacting gas prices and geopolitical relationships. It suggests a significant shift in US oil supply strategy.
en.bull_case: The Venezuela deal proves unfeasible or collapses, leaving US domestic reserves vulnerable to depletion below 250M by 2026.
en.bear_case: Trump's Venezuela oil deal successfully secures 65 billion barrels, making US domestic reserves falling to 250M highly unlikely.

en.bear_case: Smotrich's weakened position and Ben-Gvir's strength make a mutually agreeable joint list increasingly unlikely.
